description: PRODUCTION archive signed by the TEST key, and the TEST public key is offered as the keyring (R4 rehearsal: 'including when the TEST public key is offered as the key'). gpgv itself exits 0 here; the refusal must come from the acquisition-side check that the signer is the R5-authenticated production fingerprint. Extra case beyond the owner's list.
accept_basis: section 15.9 R3 acceptance (trusted checker + pinned gpgv exit 0 + keyring holding only the R5-authenticated production key); case 02 is a TEST acceptance under R4(a).
